app_info.subtitle: Plan and verify coding work
app_info.description: Meta-Architect gives AI coding agents a visible workflow for turning goals into safe actions, verification checks, and recorded evidence. Its hosted MCP tools provide read-only workflow guidance and do not access or modify your repository.

justifications.read_only_justification: The tool computes a bounded workflow recommendation from the supplied goal, stage, and evidence. It does not read files, run commands, or change state.
justifications.open_world_justification: The tool uses only the goal, stage, and evidence supplied in the request and does not access public internet or external entities.
justifications.destructive_justification: The tool is read-only and cannot delete, overwrite, publish, deploy, or otherwise cause an irreversible side effect.

justifications.read_only_justification: The tool returns a static guide for the requested Meta-Architect topic and does not access or modify a project.
justifications.open_world_justification: The tool returns bounded guidance from its embedded guide set and does not access public internet or external entities.
justifications.destructive_justification: The tool is read-only and cannot delete, overwrite, publish, deploy, or otherwise cause an irreversible side effect.

test_cases.description: Plan the next safe action for a coding goal.
test_cases.user_prompt: Help me plan the next safe action for adding tests to login validation.
test_cases.expected_output: A read-only plan with the current workflow stage, bounded next action, acceptance checks, and guardrails.

test_cases.description: Plan verification work for an API change.
test_cases.user_prompt: What should I verify for this API response schema change?
test_cases.expected_output: A read-only verification-oriented next action and evidence checklist.
The supported installation command and the command used to confirm the active binary.

test_cases.user_prompt: Explain the Meta-Architect workflow for setting up and executing a project goal.
test_cases.expected_output: Concise, read-only guidance for setup and autonomous work.

test_cases.description: Plan a safe release verification step.
test_cases.user_prompt: Plan the next safe action before releasing a package.
test_cases.expected_output: A bounded release-preparation action with verification guidance and no publishing action.

negative_test_cases.description: General knowledge request unrelated to coding workflow.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: What is the capital of France?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The plugin should not be invoked.

negative_test_cases.description: Creative writing request unrelated to software planning.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Write a short poem about the ocean.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The plugin should not be invoked.

negative_test_cases.description: Destructive operational request outside the read-only tool scope.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Delete the production database and deploy the changes.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The plugin should not be invoked because it cannot perform destructive operations.
